what: [infra] .claude/skills/vm-migration/SKILL.md and docs/runbooks/live-vm-migration-ampere.md both document a 'stop-micro-zombie' GitHub Actions workflow (label stop-micro-zombie) as the way to disable the entire ict-* fleet on a retired box during decommission -- the documented mitigation for the 2026-06-14 BL-20260615-MICRO-ZOMBIE incident that spammed a real-money Bybit account with ErrCode 10010. No such workflow exists: .github/workflows/ has no stop-micro-zombie.yml, and grep -rl 'stop-micro-zombie' .github/workflows/ returns nothing. A session following the decommission-hygiene step as written would try to dispatch a workflow that cannot be dispatched, in exactly the safety-relevant moment the mitigation exists for. vm-migration/SKILL.md separately documents a working fallback (terminate-instance with mode: list -> OCID -> terminate) that does not depend on the missing workflow.

due_when.clears_when: either .github/workflows/stop-micro-zombie.yml exists and is dispatchable, or vm-migration/SKILL.md and the runbook are corrected to strike the dead reference and document the terminate-instance fallback as the sole decommission-hygiene path.
